name: Shinagawa Refra Co., Ltd.
summary: Shinagawa Refra Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of refractory products in Japan and internationally. The company offers shaped refractory bricks, including basic, carbon-containing, fire clay and high alumina, silicon carbide, and silica bricks; monolithic refractories comprising castable and gunning refractories, precast shapes, plastic and ramming mixes, and refractory mortars; and functional products for continuous casting, such as slide gate plate bricks, submerged entry nozzles, monoblock stoppers, and ladle shrouds, as well as mold powder for continuous casting.
